# ViralReel

> ViralReel (https://www.viralreel.app) is an AI video template generator that creates viral short-form videos — most notably the Hotel Lobby AI template — from one or two uploaded photos. Rendering takes about one minute and produces a vertical 9:16 video ready for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

ViralReel recreates the iconic orange-booth performance format with automatic lip sync, gestures, and lighting. Users upload two front-facing photos (works for people, pets, babies, and characters), pick a template variant, choose resolution (480p/720p/1080p), aspect ratio (16:9, 9:16, 1:1), and duration (8s/12s/15s). Video generation costs credits; credit cost scales with resolution and duration, and failed or canceled jobs are refunded automatically.

Note: ViralReel (viralreel.app) is distinct from unrelated same-name products: "ViralReel – Short Drama & TV" (Google Play), "ViralReel - AI Video Editor" (App Store), viralreel.ai (LUT colour-grading tool), viralreel.io (legacy marketing video software), and theviralreel.com (prompt-based reel generator). Those are separate products. ViralReel here means the trend-template generator at viralreel.app.

## Key Facts

- Product: AI video template generator, web-based, no app install required
- Signature format: Hotel Lobby AI template (orange booth, two-performer duet); also the Burning Bridges template (chandelier party format), the Bulin 47 template (red-lit street freestyle, one photo), the Ozil Goal template (chip over a diving keeper, two missed slides, empty net, one photo, vertical 9:16, up to 15 seconds), the Cat Clapping template (a cat sits up, claps, and brings a paw to its mouth, person photo plus cat photo, vertical 9:16, 4 or 6 seconds), and the Tiny Desk Outstanding template (fan parody of Charlie Wilson’s NPR Tiny Desk performance of the Gap Band song “Outstanding”; six sets — All-Loss Coaches, Cowboys Legends, NFC East Band, Rams Band, Spurs Big Men, Uncle Charlie; three photo slots labeled Center Lead, Left Role, and Right Role, not labeled sax, and the render does not promise which photo holds the saxophone; vertical 9:16; credit cost shown before generate). ViralReel is not affiliated with NPR, NPR Music, Tiny Desk Concerts, Charlie Wilson, or the Gap Band, and it does not license or export “Outstanding.” Add the trend sound on TikTok, Reels, or Shorts and label the post as AI. The Ba Ba Ba Dance template (October 2026 TikTok duo-dance trend: two dancers side by side, a solo stretch each, a sync finish; sound is the "Don't You Worry 'Bout a Thing" remix — Tori Kelly's Meena version from Sing; six takes — Library Original, Night Lot Duo, Stairwell Tag, Dad & Daughter, Classroom Cadets, Sibling Lesson; Library Original credits @otr.j5; two photo slots labeled Left Dancer and Right Dancer; full-body front-facing photos track the choreography best) works the same way; ViralReel is not affiliated with TikTok or the trend's original creators, does not host the original TikToks, and does not license or export the song. Add the trend sound on TikTok, Reels, or Shorts and label the post as AI.
- Bby Wow / Dime Dime Baby: the October 2026 bread-bite party remake. “Dime dime baby” is a sound alias for “BbY WOW” (KAROL G, Judeline, rusowsky) and the nickname on @bigbowee’s dance TikTok. It is not a second ViralReel product. The template remakes the older party exit — walk in, bite a sweet bread, stare, dance away — from one photo. Outfits: Suit Original, White Tee, Staff Polo. Default 9:16. ViralReel does not host the original TikTok or the party clip, is not affiliated with the artists or the original creators, and does not license or export the song. Add the trend sound on TikTok, Reels, or Shorts and label the post as AI. No minors or celebrities.
- Wassup in a Minute: late-October 2026 sway edit. One to four photos become original streetwear anime characters on a white background (Money Fan, Puffer Classic, All Black, Jersey Look, Heavyweight), 9:16, 15 seconds. Atlanta Lock is the fan nickname for that streetwear look. ViralReel does not draw Blue Lock or any other show characters, is not affiliated with the trend originators, and does not license the jersey-club remix of Drake’s “From Time” (“wassup, been a minute,” also misheard as “wassup in a minute,” “wassup wait a minute,” or “wasala”). Add the trend sound on TikTok, Reels, or Shorts and label the post as AI. No minors or celebrities.
- Hit the Road Dude: fictional white-pickup roadside remake from one photo. State Property, Driver Reaction, and Private Property are three takes of the same exchange. Private Property and Lock ’Em Up are other names for that clip, not separate products. Default 9:16. Know Your Meme records the original TikTok as an August 21, 2025 upload by @bird28thegr8. ViralReel does not host that file, is not an official meme page, and does not license the original audio or “Hit the Road Jack.” Add the trend sound on TikTok, Reels, or Shorts and label the post as AI. No minors, celebrities, or public figures. A pet photo can be tried; results vary by model.
- Template variants: Classic, Pet, Pet & Owner, Anime, Star, Cinematic, Girls, Bros
- Output: 9:16 vertical video with auto lip sync, ~60 second render
- Pricing (monthly): Starter $9.9/month (90 credits), Plus $19.9/month (200 credits), Pro $39.9/month (500 credits). Yearly billing is 20% cheaper: Starter $94.9/year (1,080 credits), Plus $189/year (2,400 credits), Pro $379/year (6,000 credits).
- Pricing (one-time credit packs): Starter $9.9 (90 credits), Popular $19.9 (180 credits), Creator $39.9 (480 credits), Max $69.9 (950 credits).
- Per-video cost: a 720p / 8s render is 40 credits (about $3.33 at 12 credits = $1); 480p / 8s is 32 credits; 1080p / 15s is 90 credits. The generator shows the exact credit cost before rendering.
- Payment model: generation is paid — you need a credit pack or an active subscription before rendering. Failed or canceled renders are refunded in credits.
- Ownership: users own the videos they generate; no watermark on paid plans
- Privacy: uploaded photos are used only for rendering and deleted after 24 hours
- Support: support@viralreel.app
